LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_STRIKE.title: Strike
LIBRARIAN-LIBRARIAN_DEFEND.title: Defend
LIBRARIAN-SPARK.title: Spark
LIBRARIAN-TRICKLE.title: Trickle
LIBRARIAN-NEEDLE_FLURRY.title: Needle Flurry
LIBRARIAN-NEEDLE_FLURRY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Repeat for each [gold]Activated[/gold] Orb.
LIBRARIAN-COMBAT_NOTES.title: Combat Notes
LIBRARIAN-COMBAT_NOTES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-WEARY_INCANTATION.title: Weary Incantation
LIBRARIAN-FLYING_PAGES.title: Flying Pages
LIBRARIAN-FLYING_PAGES.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
LIBRARIAN-REIGNITE.title: Reignite
LIBRARIAN-FLAME_STRIKE.title: Flame Strike
LIBRARIAN-WAVE_STRIKE.title: Wave Strike
LIBRARIAN-SCATTERED_FLAMES.title: Forbidden Strike
LIBRARIAN-SCATTERED_FLAMES.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each locked Orb.
LIBRARIAN-ASHEN_BLOW.title: Ashen Blow
LIBRARIAN-SPRINGWATER.title: Springwater
LIBRARIAN-BURNING_PAGES.title: Burning Pages
LIBRARIAN-BURNING_PAGES.description:
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
Lock the Tide Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-QUIET_EMBERS.title: Quiet Embers
LIBRARIAN-COLD_FLAME.title: Cold Flame
LIBRARIAN-COLD_FLAME.description:
Gain {Tide:diff()} [gold]Tide[/gold].
Lock the Fire Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-RENEWAL.title: Renewal
LIBRARIAN-RENEWAL.description:
Gain {Growth:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold].
Lock the Fire Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-SPROUTING_SEED.title: Sprouting Seed
LIBRARIAN-SPROUTING_SEED.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Growth:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold].
Lock the Fire Orb for {LockTurns:diff()} {LockTurns:plural:turn|turns}.
LIBRARIAN-NOURISH.title: Order the Pages
LIBRARIAN-NOURISH.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your draw pile.
LIBRARIAN-CHANNEL_FLOW.title: Channel Flow
LIBRARIAN-DRY_BRANCH_SEARCH.title: Dry Branch Search
LIBRARIAN-DRY_BRANCH_SEARCH.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Lock the Growth Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-VINE_SHIELD.title: Vine Shield
LIBRARIAN-BURN_THE_RIVER.title: Kindling Scroll
LIBRARIAN-BURN_THE_RIVER.description:
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
[gold]Settle[/gold] the Fire Orb.
At the end of your turn, if this card is on the bottom of your draw pile, play it.
LIBRARIAN-FLAME_BURST.title: Flame Burst
LIBRARIAN-FLAME_BURST.description:
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Fire[/gold] to ALL enemies.
LIBRARIAN-GAP_NEEDLE.title: Thread the Needle
LIBRARIAN-GAP_NEEDLE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals additional damage equal to the difference between your back Orbs' values.
LIBRARIAN-SEVER_CURRENT.title: Sever Current
LIBRARIAN-SEVER_CURRENT.description:
Lose {Loss:diff()} [gold]Tide[/gold].
Deal damage equal to your remaining [gold]Tide[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: twice}.
LIBRARIAN-ROOTBIND.title: Rootbind
LIBRARIAN-ROOTBIND.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the Growth Orb is [gold]Activated[/gold], this enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
LIBRARIAN-EMBER_PIERCE.title: Ember Pierce
LIBRARIAN-EMBER_PIERCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the Fire Orb is [gold]Activated[/gold], remove ALL of the enemy's [gold]Block[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_STRIKE.title: Tidal Strike
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals additional damage equal to your [gold]Waves[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-BURN_ROOTS.title: Burn Roots
LIBRARIAN-BURN_ROOTS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
Lock the Growth Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_EROSION.title: Tidal Erosion
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_EROSION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
If the Tide Orb is [gold]Activated[/gold], apply {WeakPower:diff()} more [gold]Weak[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-EARTH_COLLAPSE.title: Earth Collapse
LIBRARIAN-EARTH_COLLAPSE.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Growth[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy X times.
Randomly distribute the [gold]Growth[/gold] lost as additional damage among these hits.
LIBRARIAN-DAM_BREAK.title: Dam Break
LIBRARIAN-DAM_BREAK.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Tide[/gold].
Deal damage equal to the [gold]Tide[/gold] lost to ALL enemies.
LIBRARIAN-STEAM_BLAST.title: Steam Blast
LIBRARIAN-STEAM_BLAST.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Lock the Fire and Tide Orbs for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-SEA_BURIAL.title: Sea Burial
LIBRARIAN-SEA_BURIAL.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Tide[/gold].
Deal damage equal to the amount lost to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
Lock the Fire and Growth Orbs for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-THORN_BURST.title: Recuperate
LIBRARIAN-THORN_BURST.description:
Lock the Growth Orb for 1 turn.
At the start of your next {ThornBurstPower:diff()} turns, gain 6 [gold]Growth[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-OPENING_TIDE.title: Opening Tide
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_GRAVITY.title: Tidal Gravity
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_GRAVITY.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Lock the Tide Orb for {LockTurns:diff()} turn{LockTurns:plural:|s}.
LIBRARIAN-WAVE_CURTAIN.title: Wave Curtain
LIBRARIAN-CROP_ROTATION.title: Crop Rotation
LIBRARIAN-CROP_ROTATION.description: At the start of your next {Turns:diff()} turns, [gold]Activate[/gold] a random unlocked, extinguished Orb.
LIBRARIAN-IGNITE.title: Sealed Shelter
LIBRARIAN-IGNITE.description:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {CalculationExtra:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each locked Orb.
LIBRARIAN-DRAW_BRANCH.title: Draw Branch
LIBRARIAN-DRAW_BRANCH.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Growth[/gold].
Choose to gain [gold]Fire[/gold] or [gold]Tide[/gold] equal to twice the amount lost.
LIBRARIAN-BOOKWORM.title: Bookworm
LIBRARIAN-BOOKWORM.description:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Growth[/gold].
The enemy loses that much [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
LIBRARIAN-NOURISHING_LIFE.title: Nourishing Life
LIBRARIAN-NOURISHING_LIFE.description:
[gold]Settle[/gold] a random Orb, then add its value to this card and reduce its value to 0.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
LIBRARIAN-TRANSCRIBE.title: Transcribe
LIBRARIAN-TRANSCRIBE.description:
Add 2 copies of the last card you played: 1 to your hand and 1 to the bottom of your draw pile.
They have [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-FIRE_INSCRIPTION.title: Momentum
LIBRARIAN-FIRE_INSCRIPTION.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each Orb [gold]Settlement[/gold] this combat.
LIBRARIAN-IMMORTAL_SPARK.title: Undying Spark
LIBRARIAN-IMMORTAL_SPARK.description:
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
Permanently increase this card's [gold]Fire[/gold] gain by {Increase:diff()}.
LIBRARIAN-CALIBRATE.title: Facing Pages
LIBRARIAN-CALIBRATE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Put the bottom card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your hand.
Put this card on the bottom of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-SEEDBURIAL_STRIKE.title: Seedburial Strike
LIBRARIAN-SEEDBURIAL_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
At the start of your next turn, gain {Growth:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-EMBER_RECKONING.title: Ember Reckoning
LIBRARIAN-EMBER_RECKONING.description:
Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage.
Deals additional damage equal to your [gold]Fire[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-EVAPORATION.title: Evaporation
LIBRARIAN-EVAPORATION.description:
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Lock the Tide Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-COOLDOWN.title: Cooldown
LIBRARIAN-COOLDOWN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Your [gold]Waves[/gold] do not decay the next time they would.
Lock the Fire Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-SPROUTING_BULWARK.title: Sprouting Bulwark
LIBRARIAN-SPROUTING_BULWARK.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Until your next turn, spend [gold]Growth[/gold] to prevent an equal amount of unblocked damage.
LIBRARIAN-RESIDUAL_WARMTH.title: Residual Warmth
LIBRARIAN-RESIDUAL_WARMTH.description: If the enemy intends to attack, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Otherwise, gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-SEAL_AWAY.title: Seal Away
LIBRARIAN-SEAL_AWAY.description:
Extinguish ALL Orbs.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
End your turn.
LIBRARIAN-REKINDLE.title: Rekindle
LIBRARIAN-REKINDLE.description:
Gain {Fire:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Add a copy of this card to the bottom of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-ARCHIVE_BULWARK.title: Archive Bulwark
LIBRARIAN-ARCHIVE_BULWARK.description: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {CalculationExtra:diff()} times the sum of your back Orbs' values.
LIBRARIAN-OUT_OF_CONTEXT.title: Out of Context
LIBRARIAN-AFFORESTATION.title: Afforestation
LIBRARIAN-AFFORESTATION.description:
Gain {Tide:diff()} [gold]Tide[/gold].
Gain {Growth:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold].
Extinguish the Fire Orb.
LIBRARIAN-OVERLOAD_BURN.title: Borrowed Flame
LIBRARIAN-OVERLOAD_BURN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the Fire Orb is [gold]Activated[/gold], [gold]Settle[/gold] it against this enemy.
LIBRARIAN-THREEFOLD_UNITY.title: Threefold Unity
LIBRARIAN-THREEFOLD_UNITY.description:
Choose an Orb. Transfer ALL other Orbs' values to it.
[gold]Settle[/gold] it 3 times.
LIBRARIAN-ZERO_SEARCH.title: Zero Search
LIBRARIAN-ZERO_SEARCH.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Draw 1 additional card for each different Orb that has been locked this combat.
LIBRARIAN-BOOK_BURNING.title: Book Burning
LIBRARIAN-BOOK_BURNING.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Fire[/gold].
Deal damage equal to the amount lost to ALL enemies 4 times.
LIBRARIAN-READ_WIDELY.title: Read Widely
LIBRARIAN-LONELY_SCROLL.title: Lonely Scroll
LIBRARIAN-LONELY_SCROLL.description:
Can only be played if ALL Orbs are [gold]Activated[/gold].
Transfer ALL back Orbs' values to the front Orb.
[gold]Settle[/gold] the front Orb {Repeat:diff()} times.
LIBRARIAN-DROUGHT_EDICT.title: Drought Edict
LIBRARIAN-DROUGHT_EDICT.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Tide[/gold].
Deal damage equal to the amount lost to ALL enemies.
Lock the Tide Orb.
LIBRARIAN-FOREST_WALL.title: Forest Wall
LIBRARIAN-FOREST_WALL.description:
Lose ALL [gold]Growth[/gold].
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {CalculationExtra:diff()} times the amount lost.
If at least {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold] was lost, remove ALL debuffs.
LIBRARIAN-TREE_RING_BURST.title: Rotation
LIBRARIAN-TREE_RING_BURST.description: Perform {Repeat:diff()} rounds of [gold]Settling[/gold] ALL unlocked Orbs in order.
LIBRARIAN-SONG_OF_ICE_AND_FIRE.title: Interwoven Spells
LIBRARIAN-SONG_OF_ICE_AND_FIRE.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose an unlocked Orb to [gold]Activate[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-LIFE_SYMPHONY.title: Symphony of Life
LIBRARIAN-LIFE_SYMPHONY.description:
Gain {Growth:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold].
At the end of your turn, [gold]Settle[/gold] the Growth Orb.
LIBRARIAN-DEEP_SEA_BARRIER.title: Deep Sea Barrier
LIBRARIAN-DEEP_SEA_BARRIER.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand.
At the end of your turn, gain {Tide:diff()} [gold]Tide[/gold] for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-MULTIPLE_ERUPTION.title: Multiple Eruption
LIBRARIAN-ETERNAL_GRIMOIRE.title: Eternal Grimoire
LIBRARIAN-ETERNAL_GRIMOIRE.description: ALL Orbs [gold]Settle[/gold] as though they were in front.
LIBRARIAN-OVERFISHING.title: Overfishing
LIBRARIAN-OVERFISHING.description:
Fix the front Orb in place.
At the start of your next {Turns:diff()} turns, double its value.
LIBRARIAN-SEDIMENTATION.title: Sedimentation
LIBRARIAN-SEDIMENTATION.description: At the end of your turn, [gold]Strengthen[/gold] ALL extinguished back Orbs by {SedimentationPower:diff()}.
LIBRARIAN-SHIFTING_PAGES.title: Shifting Pages
LIBRARIAN-RIDGE_WARD.title: Still Tide
LIBRARIAN-RIDGE_WARD.description:
[gold]Settle[/gold] the Tide Orb.
[gold]Waves[/gold] no longer decay at the end of turns.
Lock the Tide Orb.
LIBRARIAN-RING_CURRICULUM.title: Growth Rings
LIBRARIAN-RING_CURRICULUM.description: At the start of your turn, gain {RingCurriculumPower:diff()} [gold]Growth[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-SPACETIME_TWIST.title: Spacetime Twist
LIBRARIAN-SPACETIME_TWIST.description: At the start of your turn, choose a random Orb. [gold]Strengthen[/gold] the other Orbs by {SpacetimeTwistPower:diff()} and [gold]Activate[/gold] them, then lock the chosen Orb for 1 turn.
LIBRARIAN-LIFELINE.title: Lifeline
LIBRARIAN-LIFELINE.description: Whenever you play a card or [gold]Activate[/gold] an Orb, [gold]Strengthen[/gold] the front Orb by {LifelinePower:diff()}.
LIBRARIAN-EMBER_BOOKMARK.title: Ember Bookmark
LIBRARIAN-EMBER_BOOKMARK.description: Whenever the Fire Orb is extinguished, gain {EmberBookmarkPower:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_MARK.title: Tidal Mark
LIBRARIAN-TIDAL_MARK.description: Whenever you gain or lose [gold]Tide[/gold], gain that much [gold]Waves[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-WATER_SPIRIT.title: Water Spirit
LIBRARIAN-WATER_SPIRIT.description:
Whenever you gain [gold]Tide[/gold], all other players gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Tide:diff()} [gold]Tide[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-BLAZING_CHAPTER.title: Blazing Chapter
LIBRARIAN-BLAZING_CHAPTER.description:
At the end of your turn, lose ALL [gold]Tide[/gold] and [gold]Growth[/gold].
Gain [gold]Fire[/gold] equal to the total lost, then [gold]Settle[/gold] the Fire Orb {BlazingChapterPower:diff()} times.
LIBRARIAN-ANCIENT_CATALOG.title: Ancient Catalog
LIBRARIAN-ANCIENT_CATALOG.description: Whenever you [gold]Activate[/gold] the Growth Orb or gain [gold]Growth[/gold], [gold]Strengthen[/gold] a random other Orb by {AncientCatalogPower:diff()}.
LIBRARIAN-UNRETREATING_TIDE.title: Unretreating Tide
LIBRARIAN-OVERLIMIT_FORM.title: Overlimit Form
LIBRARIAN-OVERLIMIT_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Activate[/gold] ALL unlocked Orbs.
LIBRARIAN-ORB_CHOICE_FIRE.title: Fire Orb
LIBRARIAN-ORB_CHOICE_TIDE.title: Tide Orb
LIBRARIAN-ORB_CHOICE_GROWTH.title: Growth Orb
LIBRARIAN-ANCIENT_SPARK.title: Flame Burst
LIBRARIAN-MULTIPLAYER_PLACEHOLDER_A.desc: Whenever any player plays an Attack, [gold]Strengthen[/gold] your Fire Orb by {CrowdKindlingPower:diff()}.
LIBRARIAN-MULTIPLAYER_PLACEHOLDER_B.desc:
[gold]Settle[/gold] the front Orb.
Then all other players do the same.
LIBRARIAN-CIRCULATION_NOTES.title: Circulating Notes
LIBRARIAN-SHARED_SHELTER.title: Shared Shelter
LIBRARIAN-SHARED_SHELTER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose another living player. They gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-BUILD_CANAL.title: Build Canal
LIBRARIAN-FUEL_THE_FIRE.title: Fuel the Fire
LIBRARIAN-FUEL_THE_FIRE.description: At the end of your turn, play the bottom card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-READ_BACKWARD.title: Read Backward
LIBRARIAN-READ_BACKWARD.description: Play the bottom card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT.title: Practice Makes Perfect
LIBRARIAN-PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT.descrip: Every {Interval:diff()} times you [gold]Activate[/gold] an Orb, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
LIBRARIAN-TO_BE_CONTINUED.title: To Be Continued
LIBRARIAN-TO_BE_CONTINUED.description: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your draw pile.
LIBRARIAN-RE_READ.title: Reread
LIBRARIAN-RE_READ.description: Choose an Orb. Restore its value to the highest value it has had this combat.
LIBRARIAN-ENDLESS_TIDE.title: Endless Tide
LIBRARIAN-ENDLESS_TIDE.description:
At the start of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Tide[/gold].
You can no longer gain [gold]Waves[/gold].
LIBRARIAN-ORB_CHOICE_REREAD.description:
Current value: [blue]{Current}[/blue]
Highest this combat: [blue]{Highest}[/blue]
[gold]Strengthen[/gold] by [blue]{Restore}[/blue].
